description: This file provides utilities for parsing arguments, categorizing test targets, and generating configurations for running tests with Vitest in a project. It includes functions for building test run plans, creating command-line arguments, and managing include files for test patterns.

methods.name: normalizePathPattern
methods.description: Normalizes path pattern strings by replacing backslashes with forward slashes.

methods.name: isExistingPathTarget
methods.description: Checks if a given path exists relative to the current working directory.

methods.name: isExistingFileTarget
methods.description: Checks if a given path is an existing file.

methods.name: isGlobTarget
methods.description: Tests if a string contains glob pattern characters.

methods.name: isFileLikeTarget
methods.description: Determines if a path-like argument resembles a test file pattern (e.g., *.test.js).

methods.name: isPathLikeTargetArg
methods.description: Determines if an argument is a valid path-like target considering existence, glob patterns, or file patterns.

methods.name: toRepoRelativeTarget
methods.description: Converts an argument to a repository-relative normalized path pattern.

methods.name: toScopedIncludePattern
methods.description: Generates a glob pattern for including test files based on a path argument.

methods.name: classifyTarget
methods.description: Classifies a given target argument into categories like 'extension', 'channel', 'boundary', or specific extension types, based on its path and type.

methods.name: createVitestArgs
methods.description: Creates an array of command-line arguments for Vitest execution, optionally in watch mode.

methods.name: parseTestProjectsArgs
methods.description: Parses input command-line arguments into structured parameters for test execution, identifying target test files and modes.

methods.name: buildVitestRunPlans
methods.description: Generates a sequence of test run plans based on parsed arguments, grouping targets by category and associating appropriate configurations.

methods.name: createVitestRunSpecs
methods.description: Creates detailed specifications for executing Vitest based on provided arguments, including environment setup and include file handling.

methods.name: writeVitestIncludeFile
methods.description: Writes the include pattern list to a JSON file, to be used for selective test inclusion.

methods.name: buildVitestArgs
methods.description: Constructs the final array of command-line arguments for running Vitest based on input parameters.
